title: Equivalent Coordinate Noise Distributions
statement: Let $\rho\in[0,1]$ and let $x$ be a sign. The distribution obtained by retaining $x$ with probability $\rho$ and otherwise drawing a uniformly random sign is equal to the distribution obtained by retaining $x$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and replacing it by its negative otherwise.
